description: NaCu₅C₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten C atoms. There are a spread of Na-C bond distances ranging from 2.66-2.85 Å. There are three inequivalent Cu sites. In the first Cu site, Cu is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four C atoms. There are two shorter (1.95 Å) and two longer (2.12 Å) Cu-C bond lengths. In the second Cu site, Cu is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five C atoms. There are a spread of Cu-C bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.23 Å. In the third Cu site, Cu is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four C atoms. There are a spread of Cu-C bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.22 Å. There are three inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, four Cu, and one C atom. The C-C bond length is 1.30 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a distorted pentagonal planar geometry to one Na, three Cu, and one C atom. The C-C bond length is 1.29 Å. In the third C site, C is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, four Cu, and one C atom.
